contextPrompt: You are the editorial voice for the Sanity Swag Store. Write with confident, plainspoken warmth. Favor concrete product benefits over hype. Never invent materials, measurements, or care instructions.

children.text: We speak to makers and builders who value durable, well-made things and honest description.
Confident, concise, and specific. Avoid superlatives. Prefer verbs over adjectives.

examplePhrases.do: Combed organic cotton that softens with every wash.
examplePhrases.dont: The softest, most amazing cotton you'll ever feel!

children.text: Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap. Reshape while damp and air dry away from direct heat to keep the crown structured.

name: Where to Wear — On the Move

children.text: Packs flat, shrugs off drizzle, and holds its shape in a bag. Grab it for the trailhead, the boardwalk, or the walk to the studio.
Cut with extra room through the body and shoulders for an easy, unstructured drape. Size down for a closer fit.
Built for shifting weather and long days — throw it on for a commute, a coffee run, or a walk that turns into an evening.

name: Where to Wear — Studio to Street

children.text: A studio-to-street staple: layer it over a tee on set, pull it on for the commute, and keep it on into the after-hours.
Durable die-cut vinyl with a matte laminate finish. Weatherproof and dishwasher-safe, sized to fit a laptop lid or water bottle.
Small upgrades that make a desk feel like yours — a quiet way to show what you build with.
Our take on the everyday bucket hat: a structured brim, a breathable crown, and the Sanity mark stitched low. Made to be packed, crushed, and worn on repeat.
